Class DeckGUI

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.gui.DeckGUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class DeckGUI extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
JavaFX component that represents the card deck in the GUI. Displays a stacked visual of three overlapping card back images to simulate depth, and shows a tooltip with the current number of remaining cards on hover. The back image updates automatically when the game advances to a new age.

  • Method Details

    • buildStack

      private javafx.scene.layout.StackPane buildStack()
      Builds the stacked StackPane of card back images that visually represents the deck. Each layer is slightly offset to simulate depth.
      Returns:
      the constructed StackPane containing the layered card images

    • installTooltip

      private void installTooltip(int deckSize)
      Installs a tooltip on this component that displays the current number of cards remaining in the deck. The tooltip content is refreshed each time it is shown to reflect the latest deck size.
      Parameters:
      deckSize - the initial deck size to display in the tooltip

    • buildTooltipContent

      private javafx.scene.layout.VBox buildTooltipContent(int deckSize)
      Builds the styled tooltip content showing the current number of cards remaining in the deck.
      Parameters:
      deckSize - the number of cards to display in the tooltip
      Returns:
      a styled VBox to use as the tooltip graphic

    • installHover

      private void installHover()
      Installs mouse hover handlers that scale this component up slightly on hover and bring it to the front, then restore it on exit.

    • update

      public void update(int newDeckSize, int newAge)
      Updates the deck component to reflect a new deck size and game age. Refreshes the card count label and replaces all stacked back images with the back image appropriate for the new age.
      Parameters:
      newDeckSize - the updated number of cards remaining in the deck
      newAge - the new game age, used to load the appropriate back image

    • loadBackImage

      private javafx.scene.image.Image loadBackImage()
      Loads the card back image for the current age from the classpath. Falls back to the age-1 back image if the age-specific resource is not found.
      Returns:
      the loaded back Image, or null if no image could be loaded
